## File: facebookresearch_multimodal/torchmultimodal/diffusion_labs/models/dalle2/dalle2_decoder.py

Prompts

```
['build a DALLE-2 diffusion decoder model using an ADM UNet conditioned on CLIP image embeddings', 'build a DDPM sampler with a cosine beta schedule and noise predictor for image generation', 'build a classifier-free guidance wrapper around the ADM UNet model with configurable guidance strength', 'build an ADM UNet diffusion model with configurable depth, channels, and residual blocks', 'review the dalle2_decoder function to understand its ADM UNet construction and DDPM sampling pipeline', 'create a Dalle2ImageTransform that resizes and normalizes images to a target size between -1 and 1', 'build a Dalle2ImageTransform with custom image_min and image_max normalization bounds for image preprocessing', 'test the Dalle2ImageTransform forward pass with a single PIL image or batch of images', 'review the Dalle2ImageTransform cascaded resize, center crop, tensor conversion, and normalization pipeline', 'refactor the Dalle2ImageTransform to use a custom image_field key name instead of the default x']
```

Usage

```
{'build_dalle2_decoder': 'build a DALLE-2 diffusion decoder model using an ADM UNet conditioned on CLIP image embeddings', 'build_ddpm_sampler': 'build a DDPM sampler with a cosine beta schedule and noise predictor for image generation', 'build_cfguidance_wrapper': 'build a classifier-free guidance wrapper around the ADM UNet model with configurable guidance strength', 'build_adm_unet': 'build an ADM UNet diffusion model with configurable depth, channels, and residual blocks', 'review_dalle2_decoder': 'review the dalle2_decoder function to understand its ADM UNet construction and DDPM sampling pipeline'}
```
